items.title: Does GTA 6 have an 'easy mode'? Not officially, but there are two very important settings you can change to make the game less difficult
items.description:
By now, you've probably heard that you cannot use cheats in GTA 6 until you complete the main story. Not only that, but enabling cheat codes also locks story progression and deactivates the ability to save. Basically, you can use cheats to have a quick crime spree and blow off some steam, then it's back to normalcy. Understandably, some gamers are a little put out with this change.

Read more

items.title: Warren Spector lambasts GTA 6's "billion dollar" development - 'I just hope it's is the last of its kind even if it's the best we have to offer'
items.description:
As GTA 6 finally arrives, increasingly outspoken games industry legend Warren Spector - known for seminal immersive sims including Deus Ex - has offered both praise for the game's achievements and lambasted its "billion dollar" development model, writing, "I just hope GTA 6 is the last of its kind even if it’s the best we have to offer".

Read more

items.title: As Rockstar's alleged "union busting" tribunal hearing comes to a close amid GTA 6 launch, judge pledges to deliver verdict "as quickly as I possibly can"
items.description:
Closing statements in Rockstar and IWGB's employment tribunal case - revolving around the GTA 6 developer's alleged 'union busting' and the firing of 34 employees - have now been read, bringing the hearing to an end. There's currently no timeline for a verdict, however, with one commentator suggesting a judgement could take weeks or months to arrive.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 was October's biggest game in the US, but it wasn't enough to crack 2026's best-selling top 10
items.description:
Despite its somewhat muted critical reception, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has predictably topped the US video game charts in October. The Infinity Ward-developed shooter was October's best-selling game in the US across digital and retail, beating the month's other big-hitters, including Gears of War: E-Day and Star Wars: Galactic Racer.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 has replaced websites with social media and phone apps because "it didn't feel necessary"
items.description:
The internet of today is a far cry from the days when Grand Theft Auto 5 was released, which is partly why Rockstar didn't bring back its own satirical version of the web in GTA 6.

Read more

items.title: GameStop CEO slams 'code-in-a-box' games in the wake of GTA 6's discless release
items.description:
Ryan Cohen, CEO of GameStop - the self-proclaimed "world's largest retail gaming and trade-in destination" - is not happy with the emerging trend of games releasing without discs. Per the CEO, the industry's move away from physical games and towards a digital-only future is harmful to both consumers and businesses.

Read more

items.title: The hunt for World of Warcraft: Forever secrets continue with the discovery of an elusive pet
items.description:
The search for secrets in World of Warcraft: Forever continues ever onwards, with a new breakthrough coming to light in recent days. The latest discovery? An elusive new cat that can be tamed by hunters in one of the game's new zones.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 developers at Rockstar are worried about being laid off after shipping "the biggest game of all time"
items.description:
Rockstar has successfully shipped Grand Theft Auto 6, after years of work and more than a billion dollars spent. GTA 6 is already one of the highest-rated games ever - Eurogamer awarded it five stars in our GTA 6 review - and it's expected to be among the most successful, best-selling games ever.

Read more

items.title: After Grand Theft Auto 6's launch, players are in love with wacky criminality, in-game social media, and animal fatalities
items.description:
With Grand Theft Auto 6 launching late last night (unless you're in New Zealand, in-person or otherwise), players have been flocking to online spaces to share their favourite moments. So far, slapstick violence, animal fatalities, and the in-game social media have won the hearts of many.

Read more

items.title: It really seems like Xbox isn't allowed to say GTA 6 at all
items.description:
Like many major brands, Xbox is finding all sorts of ways to associate with the biggest game launch of the year: Grand Theft Auto 6. Unlike indie publisher Devolver Digital, however, Xbox has cleverly avoided ever mentioning GTA 6 directly in its marketing campaigns for GTA 6.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6's Japanese version only partially obscures male nudity by putting Jason in a thong, seemingly due to regional censorship
items.description:
GTA 6 is slowly rolling out across the globe. The crime epic's already available to play in countries such as South Korea and New Zealand, but Japanese players are finding out that male nudity is only partially obscured by a thin black thong that covers Jason and the other men in Leonida.

Read more

items.title: Delete GTA 6 from your hard drive and indie publisher Devolver Digital might give you a free game
items.description:
GTA 6 is out at midnight everywhere (19th November), but it's far from the only game in town. Indie publisher Devolver Digital is taking on the open-world behemoth with its very own Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, out the same day, and you can win a free copy of the platformer by proving you've deleted GTA 6 off your hard drive.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 won't let you use cheats until you complete the main story, and locks progression when you do
items.description:
Here's a twist: you can't use cheats in Grand Theft Auto 6 until you complete the entire game's main story.

Read more

items.title: Even the PS5 Pro is "not powerful enough" to run GTA 6 at 60FPS or 40FPS, Rockstar says
items.description:
Don't expect GTA 6 to get an update supporting higher framerate modes, at least, not on current-generation consoles. Rockstar has explained that even the most powerful console of the bunch, the PS5 Pro, isn't powerful enough to run the lavish game at 40FPS or 60FPS.

Read more

items.title: PSA: Some GTA 6 Ultimate Edition content is only available for the first chapter, and you'll have to put in hard graft to unlock more
items.description:
GTA 6's Ultimate Edition has proven enormously popular, despite its hefty $100 price tag. So much so that Strauss Zelnick, boss of Rockstar parent company Take-Two, recently confirmed it's the edition most people are buying - and that's despite a lack of specific information about how its unlockable content works. With GTA 6 just hours away from release, however - and out now in certain parts of the work - details are beginning to emerge, and the answer is perhaps a little surprising.

Read more

items.title: Most, though not quite all, of the 34 fired Rockstar employees are named in the GTA 6 credits
items.description:
Eurogamer can confirm that at least 28 of the 34 employees fired by Rockstar roughly a year ago - in an action that directly led to the employment tribunal Rockstar is currently facing in Scotland - are named in the credits of Grand Theft Auto 6.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 is so big, it managed to break Reddit - and it isn't even actually out yet
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 isn't even out yet, and it's already causing some technical issues over at the game's official Reddit page.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 breaks the all-time livestream viewer record hours before it's  available to play for most of the world
items.description:
Hours before it's even playable in most of the world, Grand Theft Auto 6 has already broken the record for the most viewers across livestreaming platforms like Twitch.

Read more

items.title: PlayStation has no Game of the Year nominations at The Game Awards for the first time in 11 years
items.description:
Last night, The Game Awards 2026 nominations were officially announced, and fans immediately noticed the prestigious Game of the Year category - previously won by the likes of Astro Bot, Clair Obscur, and Elden Ring - does not feature a PlayStation-published game this year. It's a rare sight for PlayStation Studios, which has secured a Game of the Year nomination every year since 2015.

Read more

items.title: Just how detailed is the audio in GTA 6? Well, even convenience store refrigerators "all have their own unique sounds", says Rockstar dev
items.description:
If you've been online at all today, you'll know that what feels like the entire world is currently fawning over GTA 6. As the reviews dropped, one thing quickly became very clear: this is a game absolutely packed with detail. Our own Chris noted that, thanks to this focus on specific detail and unbelievable nuance, Grand Theft Auto 6 is "the most unbelievable video game world ever made". And it's no accident: this is something Rockstar put a lot of dedicated effort into.

Read more

items.title: You cannot replay missions in GTA 6, but you can use multiple save files, as Rockstar explains how it made missions "harder to fail"
items.description:
You cannot replay GTA 6 missions again once you've completed them. This might be a shock to some people, since the option to do so was included in Rockstar games as recently as GTA 5, but here once you've made progress in the story, that's it. Our reviewer confirmed this in his 100+ hour playthrough of the title.

Read more

items.title: Infinity Nikki fans threaten to boycott game after promotion by Elon Musk's mother, but there may be a genuine reason for her involvement
items.description:
Infinity Nikki, the free-to-play, cozy, open-world dress-up game, is at the centre of controversy again, though this time not because fans disliked one of the game's updates. Instead, it's because of… Elon Musk's mother.

Read more

items.title: Mindseye developer Build a Rocket Boy - founded by ex-GTA veteran - has a mountain of debt, and the main plan for paying it back is litigation
items.description:
Beleaguered Mindseye developer Build a Rocket Boy - the company created by former Rockstar and Grand Theft Auto producer Leslie Benzies - apparently owes approximately £62 million in debt. And a huge chunk of that appears to be owed to Chinese gaming company NetEase (£36.5m), though more than £1m appears to be owed to Benzies himself.

Read more

items.title: Clair Obscur's narrative lead has left developer Sandfall Interactive after "wrapping up some final stuff for Expedition"
items.description:
Last night, it was revealed that Clair Obscur: Expedition 33's lead narrative designer, Jennifer Svedberg-Yen, won a BAFTA Breakthrough US award for her contribution to the hit 2025 game, which made history after winning 12 Game Award nominations last year. In the aftermath of her win, Svedberg-Yen dropped a pretty big bombshell: she's no longer with the game's developer, Sandfall Interactive.

Read more

items.title: Slay the Spire 2 is one of this year's best selling games despite only being available on PC, and its players are "obsessed"
items.description:
One million copies for each month on sale, it seems. Slay the Spire 2, Mega Crit's roguelike deckbuilder, is estimated to have sold 7.9m copies since its release in Steam Early Access in March.

Read more

items.title: "We'd love to have you" - New Zealand's tourist board gives a nod to those hopping timezones to play Grand Theft Auto 6 early
items.description:
New Zealand's tourism board has taken advantage of all the excitement surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6's launch, as hordes of players who've changed their Xbox timezones to that of the world's second best rugby team (sorry) to jump into the game early.

Read more

items.title: Blizzard suspends World of Warcraft: Forever gold exploit abusers, puts trading blocks on their accounts and removes ill-gotten funds for good measure
items.description:
Players who abused World of Warcraft: Forever's Blackmaw Hold unintended gold farm, which allowed a small minority of players to hoard thousands of gold in a few days, have drawn the ire of WoW publisher, Blizzard. Suspensions have been issued, trade locks have been put on accounts, and ill-gotten gold is being seized.

Read more

items.title: Former GTA 4 and Red Dead boss thinks "we are one Toy Story moment away" from people accepting gen-AI in game development in the West
items.description:
Ben Feder, the former Take-Two CEO who oversaw the launch of massive hits like Grand Theft Auto 4, Red Dead Redemption, Borderlands, and BioShock during his tenure, believes the resistance against gen-AI in games will vanish once the games industry has its 'Toy Story moment'.

Read more

items.title: The Game Awards 2026 nominees announced, and GTA 6 leads with eight nods before it's even out
items.description:
The Game Awards 2026 nominees have been revealed, and Grand Theft Auto 6 leads the pack with eight nominations, two days before it even launches.

Read more
category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2)

items.title: Firaxis reportedly cuts a third of its staff as studio head departs and new XCOM struggles
items.description:
Civilization and XCOM developer Firaxis Games has laid off around 60 people.

Read more

items.title: The Game Awards just confirmed who plays GTA 6's Lucia
items.description:
Manni L. Perez has been confirmed as the actress behind Grand Theft Auto 6's Lucia Caminos, just days before the game launches.

Read more

items.title: PlayStation defeats £2 billion UK lawsuit that alleged Sony forced consumers into "excessive and unfair prices"
items.description:
Sony has defeated a major £2 billion UK class action lawsuit concerning the price of games on the PlayStation Store (thanks, TheGameBusiness). The judgment came after a 30-day Competition Appeal Tribunal that took place in London, where PlayStation users claimed Sony had removed "all actual and potential competition" in relation to selling digital games on the console.

Read more

items.title: Sci-fi RPG Exodus continues evoking Mass Effect by revealing female lead and nicknaming her FemJun
items.description:
Sci-fi role-playing game Exodus continues to play into the Mass Effect comparisons by revealing the female version of its main character Jun, and with studio Archetype referring to her in marketing material as FemJun.

Read more

items.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 is the US' best-selling physical game so far this year
items.description:
The very popular and critically-acclaimed The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has set another record. After selling 5.2m copies in four days and becoming the Switch 2's fastest-selling game, Ocarina of Time has now been revealed to also be a major seller at retail.

Read more
category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2)
The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

items.title: Call of Duty might have swapped guns and tanks for knights and swords if an Infinity Ward experiment had panned out
items.description:
As much as Call of Duty is criticised for delivering the same thing every year, reports occasionally surface of attempts to take the series in bold new directions, even if none of these experiments have so far seen the light of day. And it turns out a medieval Call of Duty was also explored at one time.

Read more

items.title: Is it time to retire Dragon Quest as a series? Chrono Trigger composer Yasunori Mitsuda thinks it might be
items.description:
Chrono Trigger composer Yasunori Mitsuda thinks it may be time for Square Enix to retire Dragon Quest, while reflecting on the direction of the popular RPG series after Akira Toriyama's death. The mangaka, whose art and distinct style were foundational to Chrono Trigger and Chrono Cross - and are still used in Dragon Quest to this day - died in 2024 at the age of 68.

Read more
category: Dragon Quest XII: The Flames Of Fate

items.title: "Encouraging players to return is no mean feat" - Square Enix tempts Final Fantasy 14 players back with free game-time to fill void before new expansion
items.description:
Final Fantasy 14 is between expansions at the moment, with Evercold preparing for release in February. So, in order to keep the game populated for the next few months, Square Enix is running a special promotion in hopes of tempting players back in.

Read more

items.title: After GTA 6's original soundtrack, Justice probably won't work on any other video game ever again
items.description:
You've probably heard at least a little bit of the Grand Theft Auto 6 soundtrack from French electronic duo, Justice: a single taken from the act's original soundtrack has been released as a standalone track, and was the accompaniment to GTA 6's launch trailer. Featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and the fantastic King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard, it's clear that the duo - and Rockstar - have spared no expense on the production of music for the game.

Read more

items.title: Sony squeezes out a PlayStation 5 firmware update before the release of GTA 6
items.description:
Sony has managed to squeeze out another PlayStation 5 firmware update before the highly-anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto 6.

Read more

items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever's in-game economy has been ravaged by an exploit that allowed players to farm thousands of gold
items.description:
World of Warcraft: Forever has suffered its first economic nightmare, as a dungeon farm exploit has left some players with thousands of gold in their bags while the vast majority of players are barely above their first hundred.

Read more

items.title: EA really doesn't want you to delete Madden NFL 27 to make room for GTA 6
items.description:
Assuming you didn't just buy a PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X/S to play Grand Theft Auto 6, your console's limited storage space is likely already strained, meaning tough choices may have to be made to make room for Rockstar's chonky 212GB crime game.

Read more

items.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer is getting much-requested split-screen multiplayer and new mode in 2027
items.description:
The surprisingly awesome arcade podracing game Star Wars: Galactic Racer is getting split-screen multiplayer next year after loud fan requests, developer Fuse Games has announced.

Read more

items.title: Original GTA 6 leaker pleads guilty to hacking Rockstar Games, years after first revealing Lucia
items.description:
The 21-year-old responsible for hacking Rockstar Games and leaking in-development GTA 6 footage in 2022 has pleaded guilty to a number of offenses.

Read more

items.title: UK Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch is more worried "about the amount of time" people will spend on GTA 6 than the game's violent content
items.description:
Leader of the UK Conservative Party (and former Mortal Kombat player) Kemi Badenoch is more worried about the amount of time people will spend playing GTA 6 rather than the game itself.

Read more

items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever completionists push back as Blizzard gives them a powerful toy and then prepares to take it away
items.description:
With the launch of World of Warcraft: Forever there's a whole new world filled with niche gear and strange baubles to collect. But one item in particular has drawn the ire of the creators of a popular completionist add-on.

Read more

items.title: Ever wanted to play a multiplayer version of Cyberpunk 2077 with your friends? Well, thanks to a mod now in beta, you can
items.description:
You may have recently read that CD Projekt Red's in-development Cyberpunk 2 may be trying to revive the original game's online ambitions. But, if you don't want to wait the many years it'll likely be before the Cyberpunk 2077 sequel arrives, then I've got good news for you: Cyberpunk 2077 multiplayer mod CyberMP is now out in open beta.

Read more

items.title: Can GTA 6 make $2 billion in its opening weekend? One industry analyst has run the numbers, and seems to think so
items.description:
We all know the story of GTA 5 making more than $1 billion in the first three days it was on sale, right? At the time, Take-Two believed this to be the fastest any entertainment property had achieved the impressive milestone - music and films included. It made history, and with ease. And it looks like GTA 6 is going to do even better.

Read more

items.title: The next Xbox, Project Helix, is a console and "not a PC" says Microsoft, as it clarifies that computational power isn't sole focus this time
items.description:
Microsoft has stressed that its next-generation Xbox console, Project Helix, "is not a PC that can also play console games", but rather "a console that is also capable of playing games from your PC". The company has also underlined the importance of using gen-AI-adjacent "neural rendering" technology going forwards, and a desire to remove "all the barriers of play that have historically existed" - notably in making the past generations of games playable.

Read more

items.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby parent company plans to release seven new games by 2030 as it boasts an "88 percent hit rate" on its mobile titles
items.description:
Cyberagent - the parent company of Umamusume: Pretty Derby developer Cygames - has boasted its recent successes in the mobile gaming sphere in a recent quarterly earnings presentation.

Read more

items.title: EA hires another former Call of Duty boss to take the lead on all Battlefield Studios' projects
items.description:
EA has made some notable leadership changes within its studios group, and in who oversees the Battlefield franchise. Byron Beede, previously Battlefield's general manager, has been promoted to group general manager.

Read more

items.title: Police arrest suspect after drive-by shooting at office campus housing Xbox studio inXile
items.description:
Police have arrested a suspect after a drive-by shooting at an office campus in Tustin, California, which is home to Xbox-owned studio inXile Entertainment.

Read more

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 mod Torrent adds 3D rain, lightning storms, and tyre spray to Night City
items.description:
A new Cyberpunk 2077 mod has overhauled Night City's rain, swapping the game's flat wet weather effects for individual 3D drops and adding lightning storms.

Read more

items.title: Treyarch lays off lead Call of Duty writer and Zombies veteran after "approximately 20 years" of service
items.description:
Treyarch's former Senior lead writer, Craig Houston, has been laid off after approximately 20 years of service with the developer. In a post made to both his Twitter/X account and LinkedIn, the developer thanked fans for their support during his two decades with the company and confirmed he was impacted by recent reorganistation within the studio.

Read more

items.title: Blade Runner 2099 bosses hint at a possible "triple-A" Blade Runner game in the future - just don't expect it any time soon
items.description:
Blade Runner 2099 - an upcoming TV miniseries coming to Amazon Prime Video, acting as a sequel to Blade Runner (1982) and Blade Runner 2049 (2017) - might be getting a video game. And a 'triple-A' video game, at that. At least that's according to Andrew Kosove and Broderick Johnson, executive producers for Blade Runner 2099 and co-CEOs of Alcon Entertainment (which owns the Blade Runner IP).

Read more

items.title: The latest GTA 6 leak comes in the form of a 34-song tracklist for GTA 6: The Album, featuring Dua Lipa, Lana Del Rey, Rina Sawayama, and more
items.description:
We are now just four days away from the release of GTA 6 on Xbox Series X/S and PS5, but the proximity to the much-anticipated launch date isn't stemming the tide of leaks that has been plaguing the game for much of the past year. Yesterday, a new video - seemingly from a record store that received vinyl records of the soundtrack early - showed off the full 34-song tracklist for the game.

Read more

items.title: Ubisoft is reportedly making a new Rainbow Six Vegas game, nearly two decades after Vegas 2
items.description:
Ubisoft is reportedly working on a new Rainbow Six Vegas game 18 years after the last entry in the series.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty Endowment marks Remembrance Day with veterans' Valor Pack push
items.description:
The Call of Duty Endowment is marking Remembrance Day and its 17th anniversary by encouraging Modern Warfare 4 and Warzone players to pick up its Valor Pack, with all of Activision's net proceeds going towards helping veterans find jobs.

Read more

items.title: Magic: The Gathering animated series Planeswalker is coming to Netflix in 2027
items.description:
Netflix's long-gestating Magic: The Gathering animated series is called Planeswalker, and it's coming in 2027.

Read more

items.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker is getting a New Game Plus mode in next week's update
items.description:
UPDATE 17TH NOVEMBER: The Blood of Dawnwalker update 1.2 - the update that brings a New Game Plus mode, predominantly - is now available on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X.

Read more

items.title: Interest in The Legend of Zelda was "getting smaller and smaller" before Breath of the Wild, according to former Nintendo marketing leads
items.description:
The Legend of Zelda was in "dire straits" before Breath of the Wild gave the beloved series a massive second wind, according to two former Nintendo marketing leads.

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2)

items.title: Crimson Desert studio is implementing AI "throughout our entire development pipeline," and expects DokeV to launch in 2028
items.description:
Crimson Desert and DokeV developer Pearl Abyss is planning to further integrate generative AI into its workflow.

Read more

items.title: A new report reckons 40% of developers in the video games industry are using generative AI - but even more think it's harmful
items.description:
Despite all the outrage and criticism around game developers and publishers using generative AI in gaming, a new report from the Game Developers Conference (GDC) calculates that as many as 40 percent of developers active in the industry use the controversial tools in their work. This is up four percent compared to the same report last year.

Read more

items.title: One week from launch, GTA 6's physical map reportedly leaks online thanks to the £350 collector's edition on show in a UK department store
items.description:
With less than a week to go before GTA 6's hugely anticipated release, the game's final map - or at least a stylised poster version of it, depicting the state of Leonida's key landmarks - has surfaced online. It was reportedly snapped during Selfridge's sizable GTA 6's takeover, and is seemingly the physical map included in Rockstar's £350 collector's edition.

Read more

items.title: Slay the Spire 2 gets its first new character since its massively successful launch in March as part of "biggest" beta patch yet
items.description:
Slay the Spire 2, which released into early access earlier this year, is expanding once more with a major new beta update. This introduces the deckbuilder's first new character since launch - a whimsical musician armed with a bow - alongside two new modes, and more.

Read more

items.title: Xbox boss announces Wolfenstein 3 and confirms new game in development at idSoftware despite reported job cut "bloodbath"
items.description:
Xbox boss Asha Sharma has confirmed Wolfenstein 3 is in development at MachineGames, the Swedish studio behind the acclaimed Wolfenstein: The New Order, Wolfenstein 2: The New Colossal, and 2024's celebrated Indiana Jones and the Great Circle. Additionally, she revealed Doom developer idSoftware - one of the Microsoft-owned studios heavily impacted by sweeping Xbox job cuts earlier this year - is now working on a new game.

Read more

items.title: Will GTA 6 break the internet? UK broadband operator braces for impact, saying "GTA 6 has been on our radar for a long time"
items.description:
As Grand Theft Auto 6 breaks pre-order records on the PlayStation and Xbox stores, and looks poised to break many more sales records once it launches next week, questions of whether it will also break the internet arise. Collective network load will undoubtedly spike around its release - will regional infrastructure be able to bear it?

Read more

items.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved is getting its own four-player version of the series' staple Firefight mode, for free, "this winter"
items.description:
Last night, Xbox Game Studios and Halo Studios have announced a free update for the recently-released Halo: Campaign Evolved, which promises to add the four-player co-operative PvE mode, Firefight, to the game.

Read more

items.title: Xbox boss seemingly champions gen-AI development as she celebrates 25 years of Xbox: "A small team will be able to build worlds that today demand hundreds of developers"
items.description:
Xbox leader Asha Sharma has alluded to harnessing the power of generative AI when making games, in a memo published this afternoon.

Read more

items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever players in Australia and New Zealand are struggling to get sunlight, and not for the usual MMO reasons
items.description:
World of Warcraft: Forever players are having a blast in the new MMO, but not everyone is basking in the rays of its successful launch. Players located in Australia, New Zealand, and other Oceania countries are having a bit of a sunlight problem.

Read more

items.title: As low-effort AI slop continues to flood Steam, yet more developers announce game delays caused by Valve's growing approval backlog
items.description:
More indie developers say they've been forced to delay the impending release of their games as a result of Steam's growing approvals backlog - a relatively recent problem that's believed to stem from an influx of AI slop on the platform.

Read more

items.title: After days of controversy, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned
items.description:
Nvidia's founder and CEO Jensen Huang has resigned from his position as leader of one of the most valuable companies in the world.

Read more

items.title: The Witcher 3 uses gen-AI to enhance Geralt's Polish voice following actor's stroke - "I do think this is one of those ways where you can use AI ethically"
items.description:
CD Projekt Red has revealed that it used - and is using - generative AI technology to treat and alter the voice of the Polish actor who portrayed Geralt of Rivia in upcoming Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past

items.title: After two weeks of multiplayer downtime, Dark Souls 2 & 3's mysterious server "issue" has been fixed, so it no longer feels so lonely online
items.description:
Developer FromSoftware has announced that online multiplayer servers for Dark Souls 2 and 3 are back online following a nearly two-week outage.

Read more
category: Dark Souls 2: Scholar of the First Sin

items.title: Paradox boss Frederik Wester stepping down after several tumultuous years for the Cities Skylines and Stellaris publisher
items.description:
Paradox Interactive's Frederik Wester has announced he's stepping down from the role of CEO after a combined decade and a half leading the company. The news follows several tumultuous years for the publisher best known for grand strategy games including Stellaris, Europa Universalis, and Crusader Kings 3.

Read more

items.title: Will a Grand Theft Auto game ever be set outside of America? Rockstar offers a small glimmer of hope
items.description:
The Grand Theft Auto games have always been synonymous with America; Americana is baked into the crime series' very being. Across its history, there's only ever been one GTA game set outside America: the London-based expansion of the original game.

Read more

items.title: Nvidia board considering ousting CEO Jensen Huang, report claims, as news of a second affair comes to light
items.description:
Nvidia's board of directors has reportedly met to decide whether to remove the company's embattled CEO Jensen Huang, as news of a second extramarital affair has come to light.

Read more

items.title: Amy Hennig's Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra hasn't been cancelled, Skydance reportedly says, as rumours swirl to the contrary
items.description:
You'd be forgiven for forgetting that Amy Hennig's superhero game Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra exists, but apparently it's still in development despite its many troubles and rumours to the contrary.

Read more

items.title: Destroy All Humans remake developer goes independent, splits from THQ Nordic and parent company Embracer Group
items.description:
Black Forest Games - the studio that remade the first two cult-classic Destroy All Humans games - has spun out from under former owners THQ Nordic and Embracer Group.

Read more

items.title: Don't expect more information on The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel "for some time," Bethesda says
items.description:
After Bethesda formally named The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel earlier this month, some series fans were hopeful that more news wasn't far behind. Skyrim is 15 years old today (11th November) after all, but Bethesda Game Studios has since dashed those hopes into oblivion.

items.title: GTA 6 might be censored in Japan, if the game's smaller install size and lack of "strong sexual content" warning is anything to go by
items.description:
GTA 6 is finally coming out worldwide next week, putting an end to a 13-year wait and at least one popular meme format, but the highly-anticipated game might look a bit different in Japan.

items.title: Hell Let Loose's original developers' Napoleonic-era extraction game, Hunger, gets December early access release, and an open beta this month
items.description:
Good Fun Corp, the studio made up of the original developers behind Hell Let Loose, has finally announced a release date for its anticipated next project: Hunger. The extraction shooter-slasher game enters early access on Steam on 3rd December, and there's good news if you're eager to try it out before then.

items.title: "I wish hardware like the Xbox Series S wouldn't be released" - former Tekken director Katsuhiro Harada trashes Microsoft's console in front of senior Xbox staff
items.description:
Katsuhiro Harada, formerly director on the Tekken series, is known for not pulling his punches. This truth was reinforced recently, as he said he wished the Xbox Series S "wouldn't be released" at a developer panel. All while a member of the Xbox team was in the room.

items.title: As of this week, PlayStation 5 has surpassed 100 million consoles sold
items.description:
PlayStation 5 has officially surpassed 100m consoles sold, Sony's updated sales data revealed. The milestone was reached on 10th November, almost exactly six years on from the console's launch.

items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever secret hunters have found the MMO's first hidden treasure
items.description:
World of Warcraft secret hunters are a noble breed, known for scouring the MMO for years for hidden trinkets and treasures. With World of Warcraft: Forever's launch, they've uncovered a quest chain for an especially fancy sword.

items.title: Monster Hunter Wilds' upcoming Ascendance expansion may be getting a beta, some curious Steam backend updates suggest
items.description:
Monster Hunter Wilds's first expansion, Ascendance, is set for release sometime next year. But, judging by some very suspect recent changes to the Wilds beta app on Steam, we may be playing some of the new stuff earlier than we thought.

items.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake sells in huge numbers, becoming the fastest-selling Switch 2 game
items.description:
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has been a huge success for Nintendo, becoming the fastest-selling Switch 2 game ever, shifting more than 5.2 million copies in four days.

items.title: PlayStation's embattled shooter Fairgames has finally been cancelled, a new report says, as live service push withers away
items.description:
After years of silence, we finally know the fate of PlayStation's embattled live service game Fairgames. The Haven-developed co-op heist shooter has been cancelled, with the silver lining that the studio is not closing down or laying off staff.

items.description:
Sony's revealed the second wave of games coming to PlayStation Plus Premium and Extra this month, and there are some genuine big-name attractions, led by Hideo Kojima's futuristic delivery man showstopper Death Stranding 2: On the Beach.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 becomes the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history
items.description:
UPDATE 11TH NOVEMBER: Grand Theft Auto 6 has also become the most pre-ordered game "of all time" on the Xbox Store, Microsoft has announced. And on that platform, again, the advice is to pre-load because of "unprecedented demand" for the game, a post on Xbox Wire said.

items.description:
An alleged draft of the potentially game-changing Digital Fairness Act has leaked ahead of its scheduled publication tomorrow (11th November), containing proposals that could dramatically affect the way games operate and are monetised within the European Union.

items.description:
Rockstar Games has today clarified a few remaining details about Grand Theft Auto 6's framerate target and visual settings on PlayStation 5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X/S. And as part of the same announcement, the developer revealed a key detail about the game's cloud streaming options.

Arc Raiders, Embark Studios' popular extraction shooter, has exceeded 17m copies sold, according to publisher Nexon.

items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever might live officially on PC, but people are playing it on phones and handhelds already
items.description:
If you're a World of Warcraft: Forever player you're almost certainly having your free time drained as you chain yourself to your desktop PC to play the game, or maybe a laptop. But for a small selection of true enthusiasts, the game is already working on mobile and handheld devices.

items.title: Switch 2 and Switch consoles updated to version 23.5.0 as Nintendo quietly re-introduces eShop gifting

items.title: As investors ask about GTA 6 and AI, Take-Two CEO once again puts faith in dev creativity, states making hit games "remains the purview of human beings"
items.description:

One caller was concerned about AI - specifically about the proliferation of AI-powered compilations and decompilations that have been raising piracy concerns for publishers over the past few weeks.
